claims.claim: Quanta Services reported Q2 2026 revenue of $9.56B versus $6.77B a year earlier, while management described record quarter-end total backlog and demand tied to critical infrastructure buildout.

factors.name: grid and load-center infrastructure exposure
factors.basis: rapid revenue growth and record backlog indicate sustained demand for grid, generation and load-center construction capacity

risks.risk: Large-project execution, skilled-labor availability and customer capital-program timing can create delivery volatility.

causalEdges.from: grid modernization and technology load growth
causalEdges.mechanism: utilities and load centers require transmission, distribution, generation and facility buildout
causalEdges.falsifier: backlog and revenue contract despite continued utility/load-center capex

unknowns.unknown: Exact customer concentration and backlog cancellation protections require underwriting.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 net income attributable to common stock was $451.4M, or $2.96 diluted EPS, versus $229.3M and $1.52 a year earlier; adjusted diluted EPS rose to $4.24 from $2.48.

factors.name: execution and earnings conversion
factors.basis: revenue growth translated into substantially higher GAAP and adjusted per-share earnings

risks.risk: Acquisition activity and project mix can make headline growth less comparable across periods.

causalEdges.mechanism: scaled self-perform capacity converts backlog into revenue and earnings
causalEdges.falsifier: earnings growth materially trails revenue growth for sustained periods

unknowns.unknown: No canonical valuation or score conclusion is asserted.
